meta.purpose: Invented layout preview for Figure 8 (design analysis); not experimental evidence.
meta.configuration: Yambda-Max, V4 to V5, default fitting budget.
meta.capacity: Recovery versus stored coordinates per row and layer, one line per per-head read width. Read FLOPs are added corrected-read FLOPs relative to the native read.
meta.specificity: Each (history, candidate) pair is ranked by the share of its teacher correction (teacher read minus inherited read) not explained by the history's mean correction over its candidates; quintiles hold equal numbers of pairs. The constant gate is trained with the same structure and budget and is foldable into one candidate-independent K/V.
